form.author: FLEXIcontent Team
form.description: Category layout edited with the FlexiContent Layout Builder (GrapesJS): design ONE item card, replicated in a grid for every item of the category loop, resolving flexi_field / flexi_link / flexi_item placeholders at runtime

field.name: params_builder_info
field.description: You are designing ONE item (card); it will be replicated for each item of the category loop.

field.name: builder_enabled
field.label: Enable the Layout Builder rendering
field.description: When disabled (or before any layout is designed) a minimal title list is displayed instead.

field.name: builder_page_info
field.description: You are designing the whole category PAGE: each block renders a pre-built element of the category view (page title, category description, alpha index, subcategories, peer categories, filters, pagination, item grid).

field.name: builder_page_enabled
field.label: Enable the Page Layout rendering
field.description: When disabled (or before any page layout is designed) the classic category page is displayed instead.

field.name: show_buttons
field.label: Show the action buttons (print / RSS / ...)
field.description: The buttons are always displayed at the top-right of the page, outside the page-builder layout, whatever the block composition.

field.name: builder_grid_info
field.description: Fluid grid (auto-fit / minmax): the number of columns adapts automatically to the container width from the minimum card width. No fixed breakpoints are needed.

field.name: cat_builder_min_card
field.label: Minimum card width
field.description: Minimum width of a card; the grid places as many cards per row as the container allows. Any CSS length (ex: 240px, 18rem).

field.name: cat_builder_gap_x
field.label: Horizontal gap
field.description: Space between the cards of the same row (column-gap), any CSS length.

field.name: cat_builder_gap_y
field.label: Vertical gap
field.description: Space between the card rows (row-gap), any CSS length.

field.name: cat_builder_rows
field.label: Equal card heights
field.description: When enabled all cards of a row stretch to the same height (CSS grid default). Otherwise each card keeps its natural height (align-items: start).

field.name: cat_builder_fit
field.label: Width adaptation
field.description: auto-fit: the number of tracks is reduced to the existing cards which then stretch to fill the whole row (a single card fills the full width). auto-fill: the empty tracks are kept, the cards keep their size and the last row can leave horizontal space.
